_notes: Instance spec for hpc_compshare.py. No secrets here - the API key pair lives
in ~/.compshare/credentials.json (mode 600) and the pod's root password is
read back from the API, so nothing secret needs to be stored at all.
This spec describes the one pod used for the LES comparison runs. UHostId
pins it, so any command with no <ref> targets it; Name is what `create`
would use if the pod ever has to be rebuilt. Region/Zone/CPU/Memory/disk
below were read back from the live instance, not guessed.
Memory is in MB. Disks.Type is CLOUD_SSD or CLOUD_HDD.
ssh_port is only a fallback: once the pod is Running the API returns
ssh_alias is the 'Host' name written into ~/.ssh/config; ssh_user is root
hpc_compshare.py types                    -> MachineType / GPU / CPU / Memory
hpc_compshare.py price                    -> what this spec would cost
Name: host
